candidats.description: Looking NNW from I-64 overlooking River Road between Clay St. [later Witherspoon St.] and Adams St.. Holloway Ready-Mix concrete plant, 1220 River Road, with tilt mixer at right, so-named because the mixing drum is raised and tilted to pour the concrete into the truck . [The 1982 Louisville City Directory lists 1220 River Road as "vacant", while the 1977 Directory lists it as "American Oil Co. (Terminal)".] At Riverway Louisville Terminal, 1201 River Road, a large pile of road salt is covered by a striped tarp weighed down by old tires connected with rope.
